config.title: Errors
config.description: Critical and error logs, plus logs with no severity that mention error, exception, fatal or panic

dataSourceConfig.query: * | format if (severity_text:*) "<lc:severity_text>" as severity | format if (-severity_text:* level:*) "<lc:level>" as severity | format if (-severity_text:* -level:* severity:*) "<lc:severity>" as severity | format if (-severity:* severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as severity | format if (-severity:* severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as severity | format if (-severity:* severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as severity | replace_regexp ("^(fatal|panic|emerg|emergency|alert|crit|critical).*$", "critical") at severity | replace_regexp ("^(err|error|severe).*$", "error") at severity | replace_regexp ("^warn.*$", "warning") at severity | replace_regexp ("^(info|information|informational|notice)$", "info") at severity | replace_regexp ("^(debug|trace|verbose).*$", "debug") at severity | replace_regexp ("^(unspecified|unset|none|-)$", "unknown") at severity | format if (-severity:*) "unknown" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"\\b(FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL|CRIT)\\b|(?i:\\b(level|lvl)=(fatal|panic|crit|critical)\\b|^\\S+\\s+(fatal|panic|crit|critical)\\s|^\\s*(crit):)") "critical" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"\\b(ERROR|ERR)\\b|(?i:\\b(level|lvl)=(error|err|eror)\\b|^\\S+\\s+(error|err)\\s|^\\s*(fail|error):)") "error" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"\\bWARN(ING)?\\b|(?i:\\b(level|lvl)=warn(ing)?\\b|^\\S+\\s+warn(ing)?\\s|^\\s*(warn):)") "warning" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"\\bINFO\\b|(?i:\\b(level|lvl)=info\\b|^\\S+\\s+info\\s|^\\s*(info):)") "info" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"\\b(DEBUG|TRACE)\\b|(?i:\\b(level|lvl)=(debug|dbug|trace)\\b|^\\S+\\s+(debug|trace)\\s|^\\s*(dbug|trce):)") "debug" as severity | format if (severity:=unknown _msg:~"(?i:\\b(error|exception|fatal|panic)\\b)") "error" as severity | stats count() if (severity:in(critical, error)) errors
